query:
UPDATE auth_user
        SET status = 'deleted',
            status_reason = NULL,
            suspended_until = NULL,
            status_changed_at = NOW(),
            status_changed_by = NULL,
            deletion_scheduled_at = NULL,
            email = $2,
            password_hash = NULL,
            google_id = NULL,
            is_email_verified = FALSE,
            last_login = NULL
        WHERE id = $1
